rubric: fact-sheet.md (fixed before any run). Unit = one dinner. Revised after gate round 1 (2026-09-27): a code counts as 'fails' only when the text itself shows the problem; when the method or spice level is not stated it is recorded under 'unclear' and not counted. Chili without a stated spice level -> S4 unclear. Pizza and cornbread with no stated method -> S2 unclear. This only lowers the plain counts. Weeknight times are the model's own labels; nothing was cooked.
